# Changelog

[中文](CHANGELOG.md) | English

## [v2.3.8](https://github.com/Kyosee/VeneraX/releases/tag/v2.3.8) - 2026-10-26

### Added
- Added a full refresh on page turn for e-ink screens: after a page turn the screen briefly flashes a solid color to clear ghosting. Color, interval and duration are adjustable. Gallery modes only.
- Added a ripple page turn for iReader e-readers: tap and key page turns in gallery modes use the device's own ripple effect, with adjustable speed. The option only appears on supported devices.
- Auto page turning can now scroll continuously in continuous reading modes, at an adjustable speed. Touching or scrolling takes over, and auto scrolling picks up again shortly after you let go.
- While auto page turning is running, speed / interval controls and a stop button appear above the bottom bar.
- Added "Keep screen on while reading" to the reader settings, which keeps the screen on for the whole reading session (mobile only).

### Changed
- Auto page turning now pauses while the menu, a popup or another page is open, or the app is in the background, and continues when you return.
- Auto page turning now keeps the screen on while it runs (mobile only).
- Auto page turning now waits for a page that is still loading, and restarts its countdown after you turn a page yourself.
- The app now runs on iOS 15.1 and later; it previously required iOS 16.

### Fixed
- Fixed the app crashing on launch on iOS 15 devices.
- Fixed auto page turning sometimes stopping on its own, with no notice, while the next chapter was loading. It now stops only at the end or when a chapter fails to load, and shows a notice.

### Removed
- No features were removed in this release.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Kyosee/VeneraX/compare/v2.3.7...v2.3.8

## [v2.3.7](https://github.com/Kyosee/VeneraX/releases/tag/v2.3.7) - 2026-10-24

### Added
- Image translation can now translate Traditional Chinese comics, including vertical text; choose Traditional Chinese as the source language or let auto-detect pick it.
- Added a new Chinese text recognition model that reads both Traditional and Simplified Chinese; once downloaded it replaces the old one.
- You can now add your own source languages and replace the text detector with your own models; their size is shown before download and they are checked after it.
- Added Vietnamese as a translation target language.
- You can now add translation target languages that are not in the built-in list, under Custom languages.
- Image enhancement settings now show a live before/after preview; drag the divider to compare, and when opened from the reader it previews the current page.
- Each local favorites folder can now keep its own sort order; "Apply to All Folders" sets the default for every folder.

### Changed
- No other feature changes in this release.

### Fixed
- Fixed Traditional Chinese pages coming back untranslated or with wrong characters; pages that failed before can be fixed with "Re-translate".
- Fixed the download button disappearing for comics with only some chapters downloaded.
- Fixed the comic description appearing twice at the top of the details page.
- Fixed dragging a zoomed-in image to the right on iOS sliding the whole reader page away.

### Removed
- No features were removed in this release.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Kyosee/VeneraX/compare/v2.3.6...v2.3.7

## [v2.3.5](https://github.com/Kyosee/VeneraX/releases/tag/v2.3.5) - 2026-10-08

### Added
- Import PDF files as local comics.
- Reorder comic chapters in batches.
- Choose a custom comic cache directory, with a folder picker and an option to restore the default location.
- Connect translation services through custom scripts, with an example and a test panel.
- Search tasks and combine task type and status filters.
- See whether reading settings come from global, device or per-comic preferences, and restore inherited values individually.

### Changed
- Settings categories now have short descriptions, AI Translation has its own entry, and wide-screen settings open with content already selected.
- Settings search opens and highlights the relevant option, with an explanation when an option is unavailable in the current mode.
- Clearer task cards and action buttons, especially on phones and with larger text.
- Empty libraries, empty categories and searches with no results now provide clearer guidance and actions.
- Setting sliders preview changes immediately and save on release or when leaving the page, reducing interruptions during adjustment.
- Smoother startup handling with large caches and more efficient display of long task lists.

### Fixed
- Fixed missing pages or incomplete endings when exporting large EPUB files.
- Fixed favorites search missing matches with mixed Simplified and Traditional Chinese or pasted keywords.
- Fixed long favorite-folder names crowding the favorites panel.
- Fixed some reading options not following device or per-comic preferences.
- Fixed lengthy retries for missing local covers and reads continuing after loading was canceled.
- Fixed startup cleanup potentially removing new cache files while they were being written.

### Removed
- No features were removed in this release.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Kyosee/VeneraX/compare/v2.3.4...v2.3.5

## [v2.2.2](https://github.com/Kyosee/VeneraX/releases/tag/v2.2.2) - 2026-08-13

### Added
- A built-in guide covering AI translation, collections and hidden gestures, from Settings → About → Guide
- Comic source list can be reordered by long-pressing and dragging, or sorted by name in one tap; the order is kept when syncing to another device
- Pre-translation task cards now show the live stage (downloading images, loading the recognition model, recognizing text, translating, rendering), and expand to show which chapter is running
- Translation tasks have a "View details" button that opens the matching comic
- A performance mode for AI translation with Save resources / Balanced / Fast presets, with the old per-item sliders moved under Advanced settings
- Category and ranking pages now support multi-select and swipe-to-favorite, same as search results
- Multi-select bar can remove the selected comics from every favorites folder at once
- Reading history multi-select can add several entries to the same collection
- Swipe left on a comic for Add to collection and Add to favorites; a long swipe favorites it immediately, and a long right swipe on a favorited comic un-favorites it
- WebDAV library browser can filter the current folder by name
- Appearance setting to turn off the predictive back animation, for systems that force the back gesture without a matching animation
- New Data & Sync settings section, with backup, sync and storage options moved out of the App section

### Changed
- Chapter lists of comics you have opened before are cached and shown instantly, then refreshed in the background with an indicator next to the "Chapters" title
- Search fields and list scrollbars now look the same across the app
- Multi-select actions (add to favorites, add to collection, remove from favorites) moved into the three-dot menu
- Reading settings regrouped so related options sit together
- Adding or editing an LLM provider is back to a flat form (name, API URL, API key, model), without service-type templates

### Fixed
- Pre-translation page count and the chapter progress on the detail page no longer stall for a long time or jump backwards
- Cancelled chapters no longer show a retry button that does nothing
- Pre-translation freezing the whole app while rendering text, and words on one line being split apart
- Comic import returning 0 books for archives with chapter subfolders, uppercase extensions, or several comics in one archive; page order now follows natural numbering
- Chapter list refreshing in the background while you are selecting items
- Custom collection covers not showing up after restoring a backup on another device
- Details and preview taps doing nothing on the collection edit page
- Scrollbar still capturing touches after fading out, fighting the page's own edge gesture

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Kyosee/VeneraX/compare/v2.2.1...v2.2.2

## [v2.2.1](https://github.com/Kyosee/VeneraX/releases/tag/v2.2.1) - 2026-08-08

### Added
- Comic collections: combine comics released as separate volumes or parts into one, across sources
- Collection chapters can be merged into a single list or shown as one tab per comic, with renaming and reordering
- A collection tracks its own reading progress, downloads and follow-updates; member comics keep theirs
- Collection cover can be taken from a member comic, picked from a local image, or reset to default
- Add to a collection from the list long-press menu, swipe, multi-select, detail page menu, or the favorites multi-select menu
- Blocked tags, kept separate from blocked keywords, with a shortcut to block a comic's tags from its detail page
- Detail pages matching a blocked tag now show a notice, with the option to view anyway
- WebDAV comic library supports multiple addresses and accounts: add, edit, delete, reorder, and switch with one tap
- Each WebDAV library keeps its own reading progress, favorites and image cache; you can pick the target library when uploading local comics
- AI translation can now erase the original lettering and rebuild the bubble background instead of covering it with a solid block
- Cancel a single chapter mid pre-translation without stopping the rest
- Delete or re-translate one chapter's translation, or delete every translation for a comic
- Pre-translate chapter picker shows tabs per group for grouped comics

### Changed
- Source language, target language and text-erase mode for AI translation are now saved per comic
- Network request logs only record failures by default; full logging can be enabled on the logs page when troubleshooting
- Faster pre-translation for long chapters

### Fixed
- Continuous battery drain and heating while reading
- Pre-translation stuck with no progress for a long time
- Crash on some devices after enabling AI translation
- Translated text too large and overflowing the bubble
- Garbled text being drawn over regions where OCR found nothing; the original image is now kept
- Switching text-erase mode still showing the old result until restart
- Drag positions being wrong after reversing the order on the favorites sorting page
- Bottom row of buttons in popup pages sitting under the system navigation bar

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Kyosee/VeneraX/compare/v2.2.0...v2.2.1

### Added
- AI translation now lets you configure multiple LLM providers and switch between them
- Migrate local comics to your WebDAV library, either the whole library or one comic at a time

## [v2.1.12](https://github.com/Kyosee/VeneraX/releases/tag/v2.1.12) - 2026-07-23

### Added
- AI comic-page translation: while reading, page text can be translated and overlaid directly on the image, keeping the original artwork. Turned on per comic.
- Pre-translate whole chapters ahead of time from a comic's menu, with a chapter picker and live progress; already-translated chapters are recognized across restarts.
- Per-comic glossary: view and edit translated terms to keep names consistent across chapters, with a blocked-terms list for words you don't want translated.
- Test translation button in settings to check your endpoint with a sample line before reading.
- Choice of translation target language, now including Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish and Russian.
- Downloadable on-device text-recognition models, organized by text detection and text recognition.
- A help entry in AI translation settings that explains setup and usage in plain language.
- WebDAV sync gains a "sync local comic library" toggle.
- Progress bar while checking for follow-updates.

### Changed
- Translation results are now saved permanently and included in sync, so a page is only translated once.
- Vertical text is now supported when overlaying translations on tall, narrow CJK bubbles.
- Before pre-translating multiple chapters, an estimate of request volume is shown to avoid unexpected cost on paid endpoints.
- Refined the translation prompt for a more natural, colloquial manga tone.
- Minor icon visual tweak for a more comfortable look.

### Fixed
- Batch update check no longer misses comics with non-standard version numbers and wrongly reports no update.
- Moving with one finger after zooming into an image no longer accidentally triggers swipe-to-favorite.
- The reader top bar now reflects translating / failed status in real time.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Kyosee/VeneraX/compare/v2.1.11...v2.1.12

### Fixed
